title: The First Real Defeat
summary: Deep in the water reservoir, Ha-Jun undergoes grueling blindfolded sensory conditioning. He masters Sovereign Blood Weaving, learning to read vibrations in the air and fluids before kinetic strikes land.

panels.shot: blindfolded ha-jun standing in water wide shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands motionless in knee-deep water, a black cloth blindfold tied across his eyes.

panels.shot: ten obsidian feather daggers floating around kuro
panels.action: Ten razor-sharp obsidian feathers hover in midair, vibrating with high-frequency purple mana.

panels.shot: kuro firing first dagger at supersonic speed
panels.action: The first feather launches forward like a bullet straight toward Ha-Jun's blindfolded throat.

panels.shot: ha-jun tilting head 2 inches to the right
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his chin two inches to the right; the feather slices through a single strand of hair.

panels.shot: feather embedding into concrete column behind
panels.action: The feather embeds four inches into solid reinforced concrete, vibrating with leftover kinetic energy.

panels.shot: kuro firing three daggers simultaneously from angles
panels.action: Three daggers launch from triangle vectors: left flank, right kidney, and overhead.

panels.shot: ha-jun sensing ripples in the water beneath boots
panels.action: Ha-Jun's boots detect minute pressure ripples travelling through the water surface.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hawa ka दबाव... Paani ka vibration... Sabkuch ek clear picture bana raha hai!

panels.shot: ha-jun ducking and spinning cleanly
panels.action: Ha-Jun ducks beneath the overhead dagger while spinning his torso; the two flank daggers miss by millimeters.

panels.shot: kuro grinning with pride in air
panels.action: Kuro cackles: 'Not bad! Lekin Captain Baek projectile nahi, pure heavy steel chala raha tha!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Heavy impact ko sirf dodge nahi, absorb aur redirect karna hoga!

panels.shot: kuro swooping down with giant phantom claw
panels.action: Kuro channels ancient sovereign mana, projecting a 10-foot shadowy demonic claw descending like a hammer.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising right arm with blood weaving
panels.action: Ha-Jun summons liquid blood from his ring, weaving it into spiraling tensile bands around his forearm.

panels.shot: phantom claw striking blood spirals
panels.action: The massive phantom claw slams into the woven blood bands; the blood compresses like a hydraulic spring.

panels.shot: ha-jun redirecting kinetic force into water
panels.action: Ha-Jun redirects the entire 5-ton kinetic impact into the water around his feet, blasting a 20-foot geyser.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine impact absorb nahi kiya... Maine use ground mein channel kar diya!

panels.shot: water splashing down like rain in cavern
panels.action: Gallons of displaced water rain down back into the reservoir as Ha-Jun remains standing upright.

panels.shot: ha-jun untying black blindfold
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the soaked blindfold from his eyes; his dual-ringed irises shine with peerless clarity.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ab main dekh sakta hoon... Dushman ki muscle twitch hone se pehle uska path.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder bowing head
panels.action: Kuro bows with genuine solemn respect: 'Blood Weaving Mastery: Rank C. Tumne ek din mein woh seekha jo saalon lagte hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein First Sovereign ke blood ho, Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: bone gauntlet splint dissolving into light
panels.action: The wooden splints around his left arm fall away; the broken bone has fully fused, denser than titanium.

dialogue.text:
[SKELETAL REGENERATION 100% COMPLETE]
Bone Density Multiplier: +550%
New Trait: Kinetic Dispersal Marrow.

panels.shot: ha-jun flexing left fingers without pain
panels.action: Ha-Jun makes a crushing fist with his left bone gauntlet; zero pain, pure reinforced power.

panels.shot: min-jae running across platform waving tablet
panels.action: Min-Jae runs to the edge: 'Ha-Jun! Bureau ke encrypted radio par emergency broadcast shuru ho gayi hai!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Director Kang ne Mapo Bridge par human hostage trap lagaya hai!

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping out of water onto platform
panels.action: Ha-Jun hoists himself out of the water, water draining from his dark tactical combat pants.

panels.shot: min-jae showing drone livestream
panels.action: Drone camera shows Mapo Bridge: twenty school buses trapped behind barricades in heavy night rain.

panels.shot: director kang speaking on public loudspeaker
panels.action: Director Kang stands on an armored carrier with a megaphone: 'Ha-Jun Kang! Surrender within 30 minutes or these buses burn!'

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Ek Demon ke liye 500 bacchon ki jaan... Tum chunoge kya, Sovereign Heir?!

panels.shot: captain baek standing beside kang with folded arms
panels.action: Captain Baek stands beside him, his jaw clenched tight in visible moral conflict.

panels.shot: ha-jun jaw hardening with icy resolve
panels.action: Ha-Jun zips up his dark windbreaker, pulling on black fingerless tactical gloves.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Innocent bacchon ko dhaal banaya... Director Kang insaan kehlane ke laayak nahi hai.

panels.shot: min-jae loading decryption files onto usb drive
panels.action: Min-Jae inserts a titanium USB drive into his pocket: 'Maine Tae-Jun ke journal aur Chimera files ki copy bana li hai.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Agar yeh information media aur Captain Baek ko mil jaye, toh Bureau toot jayega!

panels.shot: ha-jun placing hand on min-jae shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at Min-Jae with deep brotherly trust: 'Tum bridge ke broadcast van ko target karna.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Screen par sachayi chalao. Main Baek aur Kang ko sambhalunga.

panels.shot: kuro expanding wings to six-foot span
panels.action: Kuro's obsidian wings expand, glowing with radiant violet energy: 'Time to hunt the hunters.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Chalo, Ha-Jun! Sovereign ki pehli real battle shuru karte hain!

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping up maintenance access ladder
panels.action: Ha-Jun bounds up the 80-foot vertical iron ladder in three explosive jumps.

panels.shot: kicking open manhole cover onto rain-slicked street
panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks the heavy cast-iron manhole cover into the air, leaping onto the street.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing on empty wet asphalt facing bridge
panels.action: Lightning flashes over the Han River; Mapo Bridge blazes with police beacons 500 meters ahead.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaj raat... main aur nahi chupunga.
